lines: Please hear me
I want to tell you
Please sing to me
I wanna hear your voice
While the pulse of time still echoes
I've locked bare words away in my chest
The colors of memory begin to blur
In a corner of a torn world
Asking for nothing, I just hold you close
That's all I can do now
Even a trembling show of strength looks like pride
Like a child who's strayed off course
Even your last voice
Was wiped out by the wind that wanders
My hand still reaching toward the moon
You vanished into the stars of the sky
"Stay by me" — even holding you tight
Your singing voice I'll never hear again
Was a siren of pouring rain
In my place, this sky keeps on crying now
The teachings I've trampled underfoot all this time
Even if I gather them up now and press them to my chest
It looks like a child's game, singing out for salvation
Like an adult telling a story
Merely clinging to words
I don't need an empty love or guidance
With prayers laid out for show
I can't touch any clue to tomorrow
Someday they should reach you —
the selfish wishes a nameless, childish poem draws, still as they are
I want to forget, just once
A sleepless sorrow holds that song close
Freezing cold shatters my sorrow
And scorching sand puts it together again
Freezing cold shatters my sorrow
And scorching sand puts it together again
If being right means throwing it away
I'd rather have a mistake that never fades
The voice I hid away like a coward — now
I should bare it once more with these hands
The orbit I grasp, the light that blooms
Looked monochrome because of my parched heart
I won't forget the scenery of today
An ordinary wish lights the ground beneath my feet
